title: Jack Blast
description: Hey, Jack the pumpkin needs your help to escape from this dark Halloween world! Your main goal is to land Jack safely in the designated safe area with the least number of attempts. Use explosive blasts to move Jack in the right direction, but be cautious of the dangerous spikes scattered throughout this spooky landscape! It’s all about precision and timing to avoid the traps. Can you conquer each level and earn three stars by guiding Jack perfectly? Dive into this Halloween adventure and see if you can help Jack escape!
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play
